question: What is another name for Chomolungma, according to the text?
actual_answer: According to the text, Chomolungma is another name for Sagarmatha (Mount Everest), the world's highest peak, and it represents the pride, honor, and identity of Nepalis.

question: चोमोलुङ्मा औद्योगिक प्रतिष्ठानको मुख्य कार्यालय कहाँ स्थापित छ?
actual_answer: चोमोलुङ्मा औद्योगिक प्रतिष्ठानको मुख्य कार्यालय सोलुखुम्बु जिल्लाको सदरमुकाम सल्लेरीमा स्थापित रहेको छ।

question: Who is the main conceptualizer, project planner, chief investor, and director of the Chomolungma Industrial Enterprise?
actual_answer: Chhiring is the main conceptualizer, chief project planner, main investor, and director of the Chomolungma Industrial Enterprise.

question: छिरिङका बुबाको मृत्यु कसरी भयो?
actual_answer: छिरिङका बुबा भारी बोकेर हिँड्दा एक साँझ हिउँमा चिप्लिएर भीरबाट खसेर उहाँको जीवन समाप्त भयो, त्यति बेला छिरिङ आठ कक्षामा पढ्दै थिए।

question: How did Chhiring get the opportunity to continue his education after his father's death?
actual_answer: After his father's death, Chhiring had to work as a porter, but one day a foreign tourist showed him compassion. After learning about his situation, the tourist gave him a scholarship to study up to grade ten and also arranged a job for him cleaning the school so he could study during his remaining time.

question: छिरिङले जापानबाट फर्केपछि सुरुमा कस्तो व्यवसाय गरे र किन छाडे?
actual_answer: छिरिङले जापानबाट फर्केपछि काठमाडौं उपत्यका र तराईतिर जग्गा प्लटिङ गरी बेच्ने काम गरे। यसबाट पैसा कमाए तर मन सन्तुष्ट हुन नसकेको र यसले खेतीयोग्य जमिन मासेर नेपाली कमाइलाई बर्बाद बनाउने भएकाले उनले त्यो पेसा छाडे।

question: What inspired Chhiring to establish the Chomolungma Industrial Enterprise?
actual_answer: After traveling to various countries and working in Japan, Chhiring realized that self-reliant and developed nations were those that used their own identity, resources, labor, and skills to sell products in the world market. Seeing Nepal import food, fish, fruits, and vegetables despite having abundant natural resources, he concluded that industries must be built on Nepali authenticity and local raw materials, exporting only goods produced from such industries.

question: उद्यमी हुनुको साँचो अर्थ के हो भनी छिरिङले बताएका छन्?
actual_answer: छिरिङका अनुसार आफू मात्र धनी बन्ने काम उद्यम होइन, त्यो अधम हो। उद्यमी हुनु भनेको आफूसँगै अरूलाई पनि धनी बनाउने काम हो, र हरेक उद्यमीका लागि उन्नतिको मार्ग पनि यही हो।

question: What did the narrator title the report about the Chomolungma Industrial Enterprise, and why?
actual_answer: The narrator titled the report Jeevan Marg, meaning Life's Path, because the conversation with Chhiring made him feel that the enterprise could become a path that makes people's livelihoods easier.

question: लेखकले सोलुसल्लेरी पुग्न कुन-कुन ठाउँहरू हुँदै यात्रा गरे?
actual_answer: लेखकले काठमाडौंको कोटेश्वरबाट माइक्रोबस चढी भक्तपुर, बनेपा, धुलिखेल, नेपालथोक, खुर्कोट, घुर्मी, हिलेपानी, ओखलढुङ्गा, ठाडे हुँदै साँझ ४ बजे सोलुसल्लेरी पुगेका थिए।
